title: SEBI Graded 6-Tier Minimum Public Shareholding (MPS) Framework for Mega-IPOs
summary: Government eases MPS (minimum public shareholding threshold for listed firms) rules for large IPOs, creating 6 post-issue capital categories from ≤₹1,600 Cr to >₹5 lakh Cr.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 SEBI Graded 6-Tier Minimum Public Shareholding (MPS) Framework for Mega-IPOs. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: SEBI notified a **6-tier MPS (minimum public shareholding threshold for listed firms) framework** for mega-IPOs. For post-issue capital >₹5 lakh crore, minimum public offer is ₹15,000 Cr + 1% shareholding (with universal 2.5% floor).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
